market.exact_rule: Yes if U.S. federal government formally charges or announces criminal indictment of Ilhan Omar from market creation through Oct. 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET; otherwise No. DC and state subdivisions are within State definition. Official U.S. government information primary; credible-reporting consensus also usable.

statutes.text: 18 U.S.C. §§1423–1428 and §§1541–1544, including conspiracy: indictment/information within 10 years after commission.
Noncapital offense: indictment/information within 5 years unless another law expressly provides otherwise. Subsection (b) addresses DNA-profile indictments under chapter 109A.
(a) Knowing procurement/attempt contrary to law of another person’s naturalization or evidence; (b) specified knowing procurement/attempt for self or another not entitled. Included in §3291.

reported_investigation_facts.attribution: Reuters cites anonymous case sources: sealed warrant search of Omar home Oct 12; possible investigated theories were conspiracy, false immigration statements, immigration fraud. Reported phone seizure, >12 subpoenas including relative; sister reportedly spoke voluntarily. These are investigative acts/theories, not filed counts or proven conduct.
reported_investigation_facts.alleged_period: Reuters says probe concerns possible false information at refugee entry in mid-1990s or citizenship process. Omar arrived in 1995 at age 12, naturalized in 2000; last act and statute unknown.
reported_investigation_facts.official_response: DOJ declined Omar-specific comment; spokesperson separately said citizenship must be lawful and government investigates when facts support denaturalization. Omar denied wrongdoing.

distinct_threads.2019_birthdate_claims: WP Oct. 13, citing sources, says investigators examined possible Omar/father birthdate misstatement on immigration paperwork affecting derivative citizenship. Unverified allegation; last act/charge unknown. https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/10/13/rep-omar-investigation-focuses-birthdate-citizenship-papers-people-familiar-say/
distinct_threads.financial_disclosures: Separate: Axios Oct. 13 reports U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro said in Fox interview her office was investigating Omar financial disclosures; not identified as immigration charge or imminent charge. https://www.axios.com/2026/10/13/ilhan-omar-investigation-finances-pirro

timing_limits: §3291 covers §1425 and §§1423–1428: 10 years after offense; §3282(a) general rule: 5 years unless otherwise provided. Sealed warrant, counts, statute, act/last-act dates and tolling unknown. 1995/2000 background alone does not establish time bar; no legal conclusion.
charge_status_coverage: No named official said a charge was imminent in sources examined. Reported DOJ statement calls search part of ongoing federal criminal investigation; it does not say charges are forthcoming. No public charge announcement located; sealed filing may be inaccessible, so that is not evidence no sealed charge exists.
